# Agent experience evaluation fixtures

These disposable repositories exercise observable behavior in the starter-free,
Agentic Engineering, and Complex Domain treatments. The runner copies one case
directory into a fresh scratch repository and never copies `oracles/`.

Case metadata is in `registry.json`; the executable materialization and checks
are in `scripts/agent-experience-evals/fixtures.py`.

The fixtures are synthetic. Their source notes use the current plain Markdown
and ontology conventions so a real initialized scratch repository can index and
validate the visible context.
